message.text:
The S3 presign runner (`s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign`) refreshes external attachment links every 12 hours.

It is wired into server startup at `server/server.go:129` via `startBackgroundRunners`, which is called from `Start()`.

The runner is instantiated at `server/server.go:162` inside `startBackgroundRunners`, making that the precise wiring site.

h01.
s3presign.Runner — every 12 hours — server/server.go:129

The `s3presign.Runner` in `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go` re-presigns S3 attachment URLs so stored links do not expire. `Run` ticks on `runnerInterval` (`time.Hour * 12`). `Server.Start` starts it via `startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go:129`), which constructs the runner and launches `Run` (`server/server.go:162`).
